descriptive_support.interpretation: Display warning only; not an inferential or forecast qualification threshold

calendar: Same ending day [previous day 12Z, ending day 12Z); driver label dated by ending day; not an issue-time predictor
baseline: Same season, precipitation-day category and known-value coverage of selected driver; ALL state
limitations: Retrospective descriptive composites; no new significance testing or forecast qualification.
Regional values are not local flood probabilities or precise event footprints.
Warnings and reports reflect observing/reporting practices and are not a complete flood census.
RONI is the original retrospective atlas series, including revised values and centered-period limitations.
PNA/NAO state bins are fixed at -0.5 and +0.5 standardized units; MJO active amplitude is >=1.
Counts are unique authoritative event/report rows; multiple events can occur on one day.
The map uses same-ending-day samples; the atlas future response-window control does not apply.
CONUS summaries have their own precipitation thresholds and event days; do not sum regional day frequencies.
